interpretation: This additive product-policy decision overrides only the earlier undecided response policy. Existing model geometry, frozen tokenizer, compute allocations, scientific study and source-use approvals remain selected. No new special-token IDs or vocabulary changes are implied by textual delimiters.
no_recipe_selection: No SFT/RL/distillation method, teacher, data import or training launch selected by this decision.
readiness_requirements: Freeze the response-format and scoring contract before affected training/evaluation outputs
Count reasoning plus final-answer generation in processed tokens, latency and total inference cost; report them separately as well
Score task answers after parsing the final answer; retain full output and account for invalid or truncated outputs under frozen rules
Preserve broad quality, useful-context and per-family guardrails; tag syntax alone is not evidence of reasoning quality
Reconcile the chosen recipe with the existing 700-hour capability envelope; if it does not fit, record a costed successor before training rather than silently spending reserve
scope: Final assistant release behavior. Base and intermediate checkpoints remain separately labeled artifacts; their existence does not satisfy this final-assistant requirement.
still_open: Post-training datasets, teacher identities and recipe from the separate codebase
Chat template, tokenization of delimiters and loss masks
Reasoning and final-answer token budgets and termination behavior
Parser and serving handling of malformed, missing or truncated tags
Evaluation and export parity under the final response format

supersedes_field.previous_value: Useful concise answers by default; effort/response mode selected in bounded post-training development, with answer quality and output cost measured. No thinking-only commitment.
